author: centennial state news
title: Clear Creek County to conduct emergency evacuation exercise on May 2
text:
Clear Creek County officials announced on April 29 that an emergency evacuation exercise will take place along Highway 103 on Saturday, May 2. Several neighborhoods, including Beaver Brook, Echo Hills, Evergreen West, and Raven Ridge, have registered to participate in the drill.
The exercise aims to help residents become more familiar with evacuation routes and procedures in case of a real emergency. It also allows participating agencies to improve their processes and establish benchmarks for evacuation times in more populated areas.
Residents and visitors are advised to expect heavy traffic on Highway 103 between 10:00 a.m. and 12:30 p.m., as participants follow the designated route east on Hwy 103 to Evergreen Parkway/Hwy 74 south toward the former Bergen Meadow Elementary School evacuation center. Public safety personnel will monitor checkpoints along the route during the event. Variable message boards have been placed along Hwy 103 warning motorists about increased traffic expected during this time.
Officials encourage all Clear Creek County residents to register for Lookout Alert emergency notifications at www.lookoutalert.com . These notifications provide timely instructions such as when to evacuate or shelter in place.
Media representatives are invited to observe the exercise by RSVPing with Einar Jensen of Evergreen Fire Rescue by Friday, May 1. Media should arrive by 9:00 a.m., park at Bergen Meadow Elementary School (1928 S. Hiwan Dr.), walk up stairs to Evergreen Fire Rescue Station 2 (1802 Bergen Pkwy), and contact Jensen upon arrival at (720)948-4735.
